changes.text: Fixed TextUI onComplete events not being called due to the funcref.
Added background blur preset enabled by default.
Added storage verification to prevent issues with invalid storage data.
Created Context Menu that utilizes ox_lib features.
Created Vehicle Indicators that displays blinkers, emergency lights, engine & seatbelt status & more.
Created Plane Hud for better immersion.
Created Background Blur feature that allows you to make a glass effect on available components.
Created Widescreen compatibility.
Added Low Status Warnings that displays low indication values and sends default notification with a message.
Added day & night cycle for vehicle components to easily navigate through visible data.
Added Vertical Alignment option for hud.
Added vehicle mileage support.
Applied SetEntityInvincible native instead SetPlayerInvincible due to customer request.
Applied asynchronous loading for routes.
Applied different logic for timers for both Notifications and Default Notifications.
Applied listeners for vehicle types. When vehicle is electric it will display bolt icon instead of gas pump.
Applied different TextUI logic to handle key controls. Now it listens for any input, removes it from the Text and parses it to the key param.
Applied different handle for 3D Perspective content.
Slightly redesigned Car Hud metric units and progresses so they're more visible at night.
Small adjustments to the size of the 3D Perspective.
Seatbelt & Engine health icons have been moved to the vehicle indicator component.
Redesigned Postion and Preview mode. Now you're able to configure interface position way better.
Reworked Player DUI completely.
Optimized both of seatbelts and car hud threads, which results in really low usage while inside vehicle.
Optimized Points feature.
Optimized Player DUI.
Optimized 3D Perspective handle.
Fixed issues with NUI callbacks not returning any callback data.
Fixed issue with Default Car Hud type containg wrong position offsets.
Fixed issue with 3D Waypoints not being accessible while on foot.
Fixed issue with seatbelt indicator sounds being played twice in some cases.
Fixed issue with Square Hud type displaying zero values as full.
